description: This file defines a class `Password` that extends `AbstractRule`. It implements password validation logic using password strength checks and password policy checks, as part of a validation system for user credentials. The class is used within the OrangeHRM system to enforce password rules during authentication or user registration.

classes.description: A class representing password validation rules in the OrangeHRM system, enforcing password strength and policy constraints.
